finding.issue: The 180-second timer starts only when authenticated add_bridge.py reaches main. Bootstrap nofollow reads and compilation happen before it; lane-run.sh invokes child without any whole-process timeout, and wrapper normally exits 0 even for child failure. The frozen command therefore does not enforce a 180-second command bound or a separately declared recorder bound.
finding.location: LAUNCH.command outer lane-run.sh 0 + in-memory Python bootstrap; add_bridge.py signal starts in main
finding.requiredCorrection: Version a bounded outer recorder covering bootstrap, child execution and cleanup, preserving actual lane child exit in a one-shot recorder/result, with explicit child/recorder limits and process-group termination. Independently static- and exact-review the new command; do not relabel r1 exact ACCEPT.
